clips.text: Okay, that eraser just took out the floor, and I'm on that floor. I drew this place, so you'd think I'd know how to leave. Look around: door on the left, torn paper on the right. Press one for the door, or two for the tear.
Oh, of course. It's a drawing of a door. I gave it a doorknob and absolutely no depth.
Wait, there's actual space behind the paper. We can get through that! My best exit is the bit I didn't draw.
